mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_order (order_no, user_id, total_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, coupon_id, status, receiver_info, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{couponId}, #{status}, #{receiverInfo}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_order SET status = #{toStatus} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE t_order SET status = 1, pay_time = #{payTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
UPDATE t_order SET status = 3, finish_time = #{finishTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2
UPDATE t_order SET status = 6 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 5
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_order WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < #{beforeTime}
